text: {"lessons":["My account has risen steadily while I made no trades, so I should avoid trading just to feel active.","Selling 30 shares of Stock E after a large gain does not tell me whether I timed it well; I should make decisions based on my needs and the stock’s prospects, not the gain alone.","As a retiree relying on these savings, I should prioritize preserving value, keeping risk manageable, and avoiding large swings."]}
